jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead, Product & Engineering
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.



Role Description

We are seeking a Strategic Finance Lead to serve as a key partner to Plaid’s Engineering and Product  organization. This person will own product-level revenue and gross margin forecasting, as well as the analytical frameworks that guide how Plaid deploys capital and allocates resources across these areas.



As the Strategic Finance Lead, Product & Engineering, you will lead the finance partnership for a set of critical product areas, working directly with the relevant Product and Engineering leaders.



Responsibilities

 - Product-Level Forecasting. Own revenue and gross margin forecasts for your product areas, balancing bottom-up builds with top-down sanity checks to arrive at the most robust point of view.

 - Resource Allocation & Capacity Planning. Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on headcount planning, roadmap-based capacity forecasting, and OpEx discipline, surfacing and supporting the resolution of trade-offs.

 - Performance Visibility. Own the recurring reporting cadence for your product areas, including KPI tracking, variance analysis, and the early identification of risks and opportunities.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership. Serve as the primary finance partner to Product and Engineering leaders in your areas, and coordinate with GTM Finance on go-to-market approach, targets and economics.

 - Board & Executive Materials. Contribute analysis and narrative to the quarterly Board deck and ad hoc strategic reviews.

 - Mentorship. Mentor junior members of the Strategic Finance team in financial modeling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder management.



Qualifications

 - 8+ years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, management consulting, investment banking, or private equity, including direct exposure to product or engineering finance at a high-growth technology company.

 - Strong command of product P&L mechanics, including revenue and gross margin forecasting, headcount and capacity planning, and software unit economics.

 - Comfortable owning ambiguous, judgment-intensive problems with minimal oversight, while exercising sound judgment about when to escalate.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into a clear narrative for Product, Engineering, and executive audiences.

 - A natural mentor who is energized by developing junior team members, even without a formal reporting line.

 - Experience partnering directly with Product or Engineering leaders is strongly preferred. Fintech or financial services experience is a plus but not required.

FINANCE MULTIPLIES PLAID'S POTENTIAL. WE TURN INSIGHT INTO ACTION, CAPITAL INTO MOMENTUM, AND DISCIPLINE INTO THE KIND OF GROWTH THAT COMPOUNDS FOR THE LONG RUN.



Plaid's Corporate Development function drives inorganic growth, evaluating and executing M&A and investment opportunities that extend Plaid's product, technology, and market position.  - M&A & Investment Strategy. Build and own a proactive pipeline of acquisition and investment opportunities aligned to Plaid's strategic priorities. Maintain an up-to-date view of the competitive and startup landscape to identify targets before they're formally for sale.

 - Outbound Relationship Building. Build and nurture a network of founders, executives, and investors across fintech and adjacent markets to source proprietary deal flow.

 - Market & Competitive Intelligence. Develop well-researched and insightful points of view on adjacent categories and key competitors, and use that intelligence to help inform Plaid's strategic direction and investment priorities.

 - Deal Execution & Diligence. Lead end-to-end deal execution: valuation, financial modeling, diligence coordination, negotiation, and structuring, partnering with key cross-functional throughout.

 - Post-Deal Integration & Accountability. Partner with Finance, Legal, People and business leaders to successfully integrate closed acquisitions. Set a clear integration plan with milestones and performance metrics, track integration milestones and backtest outcomes against the original investment thesis.

 - Cross-Functional Orchestration. Engage Product, Engineering, and GTM to qualify opportunities and sharpen Plaid's areas of strategic interest.

 - Executive & Board Communication. Prepare board- and executive-ready materials on market landscape, deal pipeline, deal evaluation and due diligence findings, integration plan and post-close performance.

 - Experience. 12+ years of experience across Investment Banking, Private Equity, Corporate Development or Management Consulting (with a focus on PE due diligence work).

 - Deal Execution. Deep, hands-on experience evaluating and executing deals end-to-end, including sourcing, valuation, financial modeling, diligence, negotiation, and closing.

 - Track Record. A track record of managing multiple complex deals simultaneously, from inception through post-close integration.

 - Judgment. Strong analytical rigor paired with sound business judgment, knowing when to dig deeper and when to move forward with a decision.

 - Builder Mindset. Comfort building frameworks and processes, turning ambiguity into repeatable motions.

 - Communication. Executive presence and excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and Board-level audiences.

 - Industry experience. Prior experience in Technology is a must-have. Experience partnering with Product and Engineering leaders is a plus; fintech or financial services experience is a plus.

   - Define the discipline and the architecture — how GRC Engineering works at Plaid, not just execute within it.
   
   - Build the foundation the function runs on — a codified source of truth for controls, policies, and evidence, fed by live pipelines and continuous controls monitoring.
   
   - Be the engineering backbone for Security Assurance & Trust Enablement, Third-Party Ecosystem Risk, and Risk Management
   
   - Make risk visible and data-driven — turning control and risk data into real-time signals for the team and leadership.

   - You think in systems: you'd rather design the thing that eliminates a whole class of manual work than automate one task at a time.
   
   - You love building and shipping internal tools and solutions that people actually use.
   
   - You're relentlessly curious — you poke, you investigate, and you dig into how controls can silently fail, drift, or get bypassed so you can catch it automatically.
   
   - You treat every roadblock as just an obstacle to route around — you don't back down, because there's always a path.
   
   - You like range — juggling several problems across security, risk, compliance, and engineering beats grinding on a single one.
   
   - You're energized by turning compliance from a documentation exercise into demonstrable, continuous, machine-readable evidence.
